item.title: Man Allegedly Threatens To Kill Trump’s Head Of Kennedy Center
item.description: A Virginia man is being detained for allegedly threatening to kill Kennedy Center president Richard Grenell.

item.title: Somali Fraudster In Minnesota Had Sights Set On New State To Loot
item.description: Years before Minnesota welfare fraud captured the nation's attention, a Somali-American leader of one massive scheme expanded his assets beyond the North Star State, according to the Department of Justice (DOJ).

item.title: Incoming Democrat Gov. Abigail Spanberger Appoints DEI Director Who Cheered On Dismantling Constitution
item.description: Democratic Virginia Governor-elect Abigail Spanberger has appointed a chief diversity officer who previously appeared to agree with comments about parts of the U.S. Constitution needing to be dismantled.

item.title: Mamdani To Use At Least Three Qurans For Swearing-In Ceremonies
item.description: New York City Mayor-elect Zohran Mamdani is set to make history when he is sworn in to office on Thursday on a Quran, and is expected to use at least three separate copies of the Islamic holy book throughout the day, the New York Times (NYT) first reported.

item.title: Nick Shirley Says People Telling Him He’ll Be ‘Kirked’ After Viral Somali Fraud Video
item.description: YouTuber Nick Shirley said on "PBD Podcast" on Wednesday that people have been telling him he will be assassinated like Turning Point USA (TPUSA) founder Charlie Kirk after his viral video on alleged Somali fraud.

item.title: The Biggest Parental Rights Fights Of 2025 — And What Parents Face Next
item.description: Here are some of the biggest parental rights fights of the year, and a look at what parents can expect next in 2026.

item.title: JORGE MARTINEZ: America First Is Winning, And Democrats Have No Answer For 2026
item.description: The American people do not need spin. They need results. And the contrast heading into 2026 and the midterm elections could not be clearer.

item.title: Trump Expands Child Care Funding Freeze Beyond Minnesota
item.description: The Trump administration is widening a federal freeze on child care funding beyond Minnesota as the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) ramps up a nationwide review aimed at rooting out fraud.

item.title: MEHEK COOKE: Hey Dems, What Happened To ‘Trust The Intel Community’?
item.description: One of the great hypocrisies of the Trump era is Democrats’ selective faith in the intelligence community. For years, Democrats demanded blind trust in the FBI, CIA, and Justice Department.

item.title: 10 Times Democrats, Corporate Media Leaped To Defend Somalis Despite Massive Fraud Scandals
item.description: Democrats and the corporate media rushed to defend Somalis throughout the end of 2025 as reports emerged that they committed widespread fraud in Minnesota.
